metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: It captures the sharp, witty teen dialogue and high school hierarchy found in Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: A quintessential feel-good comedy featuring a strong female lead that mirrors the charm and fashion-forward nature of Clueless.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: An ideal mix of adventure, humor, and fantasy that aligns perfectly with your interest in Dungeons & Dragons and Jumanji.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Like Thor: Ragnarok, this blends high-octane space action with a heavy dose of irreverent humor and a great soundtrack.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you are looking forward to the third installment, this original whodunit offers the same witty mystery and ensemble fun.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: Shares the high-concept video game adventure vibes and lighthearted action found in Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant buddy-cop comedy that matches the sharp writing and crime-comedy elements of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black (who did The Nice Guys), this is a hilarious and stylish neo-noir crime comedy.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A modern teen comedy with a clever script that pays homage to 80s and 90s classics like 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A foundational 'comfort movie' that blends fantasy, romance, and comedy in a way that fans of Practical Magic will love.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical and uplifting fantasy adventure that matches the magical tone of Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A high-energy, fun teen comedy from the same era as Clueless that remains a feel-good classic.

metas.name: Borat: Cultural Learnings of America for Make Benefit Glorious Nation of Kazakhstan
metas.description: If you enjoyed the provocative and absurdist humor of Brüno, this is Sacha Baron Cohen's most acclaimed work.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious action-comedy that subverts genre tropes, offering the same level of fun as Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A modern comedy hit with a mystery twist that provides the same kinetic energy and laughs as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A fast-paced, stylized action movie with a comedic heart, perfect for fans of Thor: Ragnarok's tone.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A smooth, stylish heist film that captures the cool, witty crime-comedy essence seen in Get Shorty.

metas.name: Liar Liar
metas.description: Features Jim Carrey at his comedic peak, offering the same high-energy physical comedy as Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Dumb and Dumber
metas.description: A classic slapstick comedy that fans of Ace Ventura's zany humor will find incredibly nostalgic and funny.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: Combines stylish action with a playful, tongue-in-cheek tone similar to the modern Jumanji films.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The direct sequel to Knives Out, continuing the colorful, fun, and lighthearted mystery aesthetic you clearly enjoy.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful blend of live-action fantasy and romantic comedy that hits the same 'comfort' notes as Practical Magic.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A surprisingly smart and very funny action-comedy reboot that matches the 'fun action' criteria perfectly.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever and uplifting romantic comedy with a sci-fi twist that offers a fresh take on the genre.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A fun, jungle-set adventure comedy that channels the spirit of Jumanji and the classic adventure films you like.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: An easy-to-watch, lighthearted comedy with great music and a focus on friendship and fun.

metas.name: Men in Black
metas.description: A perfect sci-fi action comedy that balances high stakes with humor, much like Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: If you liked the irreverent and self-aware humor of Thor: Ragnarok, this is the ultimate high-octane fun action pick.

metas.name: Confess, Fletch
metas.description: An underrated gem that revives the witty, dry-humor mystery style found in Get Shorty.

metas.name: The School for Good and Evil
metas.description: A visually lush fantasy adventure that appeals to the same audience as Fantastic Beasts and D&D.

metas.name: She's All That
metas.description: A staple of the late-90s teen rom-com era that fits perfectly alongside 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult classic that blends martial arts, fantasy, and comedy in a way that modern adventures like D&D emulate.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A magical, lighthearted fantasy-romance that is both relaxing and intellectually stimulating.

metas.name: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
metas.description: A hilarious and meta action-comedy that focuses on fun and 'high-octane' buddy dynamics.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A high-energy, visually unique action comedy that feels like a live-action comic book or video game.

metas.name: Ready Player One
metas.description: A big-budget adventure filled with pop culture references that matches the scale of Pacific Rim: Uprising.

metas.name: Heathers
metas.description: For fans of 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a slightly darker but essential classic of the high school comedy genre.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A surprisingly charming and feel-good post-apocalyptic adventure that is very easy to watch.

metas.name: Yesterday
metas.description: An uplifting, high-concept romantic comedy centered around the music of The Beatles that is pure comfort cinema.

metas.name: The Birdcage
metas.description: An incredibly funny and heartwarming comedy about family and acceptance that is perfect for a relaxing night.
